title: Design a Parking Lot
summary: Design a multi-level parking lot that supports different vehicle types and pricing.
requirements: The parking lot can have multiple floors.
Different spot sizes can accept different vehicle types.
A vehicle can be parked and unparked.
The system should issue a ticket and calculate parking fees.
The design should allow pricing rules to change without rewriting ParkingLot.

title: Design a Vending Machine
summary: Design a vending machine that handles product selection, payment, inventory and change.
requirements: Products have price and inventory.
A customer can select a product and insert money.
The machine should reject invalid selections and insufficient payment.
The machine returns change and handles cancellation.
The design should make state transitions explicit.

title: Design an Elevator System
summary: Design a system that dispatches elevators to floor requests.
requirements: There are multiple elevators.
Users can request an elevator from a floor.
The controller chooses an elevator based on a dispatch policy.
Elevators move between floors and have a direction/state.
The dispatch policy should be replaceable.

title: Design a Rate Limiter
summary: Design a rate limiter that supports multiple algorithms and per-client limits.
requirements: Clients can be limited independently.
The system should expose an allow/deny decision.
Different algorithms such as token bucket or fixed window may be supported.
The algorithm should be replaceable without changing callers.
The design should discuss concurrency and clock assumptions.
